an5.154:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcime bhikkhave, dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattanti.
an5.154:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu na sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ suṇanti. na sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti. na sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ dhārenti. na sakkaccaṃ dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhanti. na sakkaccaṃ atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammaṃ paṭipajjanti.
an5.154:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave, pañca dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattanti.
an5.154:2.1: pañcime bhikkhave, dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattanti.
an5.154:2.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ suṇanti. sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti. sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ dhārenti. sakkaccaṃ dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhanti. sakkaccaṃ atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammaṃ paṭipajjanti.
an5.154:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattantīti.
